protocol.analysis: Point 20: dependent Spearman differences, paired reconstructing bootstrap
protocol.rng: NumPy default_rng PCG64; indices generated as uint8
protocol.pairing: One shared row-index sample for experimental output and all scorer outputs, and all 12 contrasts.
protocol.statistic: Within each resample, recompute average component ranks, rank/size normalisation, exact twice-rank products for AR/AT and average ranks of each composite; calculate Spearman as Pearson correlation of average ranks.
protocol.model_predictions: Fixed archived oriented values; no retraining or inference.
protocol.composite_membership: Fixed, outcome-independent membership as in source protocol.
protocol.multiplicity: One family of 12 contrasts; Bonferroni alpha=.05/12.
protocol.jackknife: 39 delete-one samples, each with 38 constructs and reconstructed component ranks/composites.
protocol.bias_correction: midrank: (# bootstrap statistics below observed + 0.5 # equal) / B
protocol.primary_conclusion: Corrected BCa lower confidence bound > 0; no use of bootstrap sign fractions as p-values.
protocol.diagnostics: Finite bias correction and acceleration; ordered finite transformed probabilities, positive BCa denominators; report tail support and decisions in two disjoint 100000-draw halves.
protocol.scope: Construct-level resampling conditional on this experimental readout and fixed model predictions. Assay, digitization and model-training errors not resampled.
